verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of a one-click repository install or GitHub app integration that grants agents repo access. MCP server connections and connecting machines are adjacent capabilities, not repo integration. The only GitHub mention is a community report of an OAuth error while connecting GitHub, which hints a connection flow exists but documents no working one-click capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can grant an agent access to my repositories with a one-click install, without complex setup
